 Bianca Gonzalez shares post-eviction process of 'PBB' housemates
 Drew Acierto ,
 ABS-CBN News
 Published November 17, 2026 11:46 AM PHT 
 "Pinoy Big Brother" host and former housemate Bianca Gonzalez shared how the show prepares the new evictees into their new reality in the outside world. 
 In her X account, Gonzalez assured the casual fans and viewers of the hit reality show that the ex-housemates are well taken care of after they’re eliminated.
 Calix Esguerra and Kapuso housemate Ethan Benares were the first two housemates to be evicted in "PBB Collab 3.0." 
 Calix at Ethan, unang Kapamilya at Kapuso evictee sa 'PBB Collab 3.0' “To all the new fans and viewers of PBB, we would like you to know that right after eviction, the process is that our team talks to the evictees first to tell them about everything that happened in the outside world while they were inside,” Gonzalez wrote.
 ADVERTISEMENT
 She revealed that the former housemates will be given all the information that they need to know ––  viewers’ impressions and both the good and bad feedback. A psychologist is also present if needed by an ex-housemate as shared by Gonzalez herself.
 “Once cleared, they can go home with their loved ones and only then will they have access to their phones,” she added.
 Gonzalez maintained that the "PBB" staff will be guiding and supporting the ex-housemates even after their stay inside the iconic house.
